variants.body:
What would you change about your weekly report if you trusted every figure?

Think about your Monday morning. The report lands in your inbox, but before anyone acts on it, the inventory numbers get hand-checked against order records. In a survey of 120 operations leaders, 62% said they did not fully trust the inventory figures in their weekly report. That is a data quality problem sitting in operations, not a glitch for IT to fix.

When the figures need verification by hand, decisions slow down. The hours spent on manual reconciliation are hours not spent moving stock.

Tell us in the comments what you would change about your weekly report if the figures needed no hand-checking.
